card.name: Final letters of capitalized abbreviations
card.fires_on: The last letters of an acronym or unit abbreviation, such as LSAT, pH, OSHA, USGS, DBMS, KB, and the CI in 95% CI. It appears where the abbreviation is just about to be completed or followed by a number or explanation.

modes.label: Acronym endings
modes.description: The final letters of an all-caps organization or test acronym.

modes.label: pH and CI in numeric results
modes.description: The H of pH or the CI after 95% right before a numeric value.

modes.label: Unit abbreviations
modes.description: A unit such as KB right after a number.

card.plain: It fires on the last letters of short abbreviations like pH, CI, or OSHA, just before the text continues with a value or explanation.
